_comment: Phase 6C Pass 2: Semi-enzymatic search on subset FASTA. Run AFTER Pass 1 and digestion_efficiency.py subset. Update fasta path to the generated subset file (inputs/subset_identified_proteins.fasta).
_recon_note: Values here are OVERRIDDEN AT RUNTIME. Pass 2 sets precursor_tol, fragment_tol, isotope_errors, database.fasta and the mods from what pass 1 measured; pass 1 sets fragment_tol, the mods, database.fasta and mzml_paths. They are written honestly here so the template cannot be misread as a record of what ran. The record of what ran is the effective-params.json written beside each search, and Sage's own results.json beside it.
